name: Jin Xiaotang
current_role: Director and General Manager, Shanghai Beite Technology Group (北特科技, SSE: 603009)
profile: Jin Xiaotang (靳晓堂) is the son of Beite founder and controlling shareholder Jin Kun, acts in concert with him, and holds ~8% of the Shanghai-listed auto-parts maker (steering rack bars, shock-absorber rods, A/C compressors, aluminium parts). He has been a director and general manager since January 2019; in 2025 the company renamed itself Shanghai Beite Technology Group.
interesting_fact: Beite is pivoting into humanoid robotics: in 2024 it set up Jiangsu Beite Robot Technology to make planetary roller screws, planning ~2.6m sets/yr in Kunshan plus a Thailand base, an RMB 1.85bn bet.
notes: Wealth shared with father Jin Kun (chairman, ~31.6%). Low public profile; route via company board secretary Liu Gongyou (IR email above). Role per 2024 acquisition report; check latest SSE filings to confirm GM title.

name: Gail Jones
current_role: Former co-founder, managing director and acting CEO of UKFast (Manchester hosting/cloud provider); no current public operating role identified
profile: Gail Jones co-founded Manchester web-hosting firm UKFast in 1999 with her husband Lawrence Jones and grew it into one of the UK's largest independent hosting/cloud providers with its own data-centre campus (UKFast Campus, Trafford). She became MD in 2017 and led the firm after Lawrence stepped down in 2019; the family sold its remaining interest to Inflexion in 2020, and UKFast was merged into ANS.
interesting_fact: UKFast ran its own Manchester data-centre estate (MaNOC) and in 2017 split its leadership into two MD roles, with co-founder Gail Jones taking the managing director post to drive cloud growth.
notes: Left UKFast in 2020 (FT). Very low public profile since. Sensitive: husband Lawrence Jones was convicted in 2023 of rape/sexual offences; avoid referencing him in outreach. Reported prior board roles at Tech Manchester and Manchester Foundation Trust Charity (unverified on primary sources). No published contact found.
